gloss: to be postponed; to be extended; to be delayed

definitions.gloss: to be postponed; to be delayed
definitions.explanation: For a scheduled event, deadline, or plan to be pushed back to a later time.

definitions.gloss: to be extended; to be prolonged
definitions.explanation: For a period, distance, or duration to become longer.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}の{完成|かんせい}が{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}{延|の}びた。
examples.english: The completion of the construction was delayed by one month.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}のせいで{試合|しあい}が{来週|らいしゅう}に{延|の}びてしまった。
examples.english: Because of the rain, the game was postponed to next week.

examples.japanese: {寿命|じゅみょう}が{延|の}びた。
{道路|どうろ}が{郊外|こうがい}まで{延|の}びている。
examples.english: The road extends out to the suburbs.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{医療|いりょう}のおかげで{平均寿命|へいきんじゅみょう}が{大幅|おおはば}に{延|の}びた。
examples.english: Thanks to new medical care, average life expectancy has been greatly extended.

notes:
An ichidan verb meaning to be postponed or extended. Uses the kanji {延|えん} (to extend, to postpone), distinguishing it from the homophone {伸|の}びる (to stretch, to grow). The key difference is that {延|の}びる concerns time, schedules, and durations, while {伸|の}びる concerns physical stretching or growth.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. The transitive counterpart is {延|の}ばす (to postpone, to extend).

KANJI NOTE:
- {延|の}びる — for time, schedules, deadlines, distances, and durations
- {伸|の}びる — for physical stretching, growth, and improvement

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会議|かいぎ}が{延|の}びる — a meeting runs over / is delayed
- {期限|きげん}が{延|の}びる — a deadline is extended
- {寿命|じゅみょう}が{延|の}びる — lifespan is extended
- {工期|こうき}が{延|の}びる — the construction period is extended

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {伸|の}びる — to stretch, to grow; focuses on physical extension or improvement in ability
- {遅|おく}れる — to be late; emphasizes being behind schedule, while {延|の}びる means the schedule itself has been pushed back
